title: #469 The Design of Buildings
prompt: How does the design of buildings affect the places, positively or negatively, where people live and work?

promptSegments.text: How does the design of buildings affect the places, positively or negatively, where people live and work?

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.
requirements.vi: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng và nhất quán khi đề yêu cầu ý kiến.

requirements.en: Develop each main idea with explanation and an example.
requirements.vi: Phát triển mỗi ý chính bằng giải thích và ví dụ.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Good building design helps people feel safe and happy in their homes.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Good building design helps people feel safe and happy in their homes.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Building design also makes it easier for people to travel to work.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Building design also makes it easier for people to travel to work.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Poor building design can make neighborhoods feel closed and unfriendly.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Poor building design can make neighborhoods feel closed and unfriendly.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Poor design can also make movement and travel difficult for people.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Poor design can also make movement and travel difficult for people.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Good architectural design improves the quality of life and builds a strong community.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Good architectural design improves the quality of life and builds a strong community.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Building design positively influences daily routines and supports a healthy, active lifestyle.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Building design positively influences daily routines and supports a healthy, active lifestyle.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Poor building design can weaken community life by making neighborhoods feel isolated and unfriendly.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Poor building design can weaken community life by making neighborhoods feel isolated and unfriendly.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Poor design can also make daily life less convenient for residents by creating traffic problems and making walking difficult.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Poor design can also make daily life less convenient for residents by creating traffic problems and making walking difficult.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: Explore how architectural design influences the livability and functionality of living and working spaces, considering both positive and negative impacts.
outline: body1: Positive effects of building design on living and working environments
body2: Negative effects of building design on communities
keyArguments: Effective design enhances productivity and well-being through ergonomics and accessibility.
Poor design can lead to issues like urban sprawl and socioeconomic disparities.
